basic_details.job_title: GBU Junior Research Fellow (Biotechnology) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Gujarat Biotechnology University (GBU) is filling 2 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) positions on a Department of Biotechnology, Govt. of India funded research project, with a fellowship of Rs. 37,000 + 9% HRA p.m. Applicants need M.Tech/M.Sc (Biotechnology or relevant life sciences discipline) with a minimum of 55% marks and a qualifying NET/JRF/GATE score. Applications go through the online Google Form, with the latest CV, on or before 5 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: GBU Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Development and Validation of Innovative Agrobiological Formulations for Drought Stress Mitigation in Economically Important Legume and Vegetable Crops
Department of Biotechnology, Govt. of India
Till the end of the project, initially offered for 01 year (subject to satisfactory performance)
Up to 30 years on the closing date of advertisement

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 2 positions of Junior Research Fellow (JRF). The desirable experience is described separately as JRF#1 and JRF#2. The notice prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: M.Tech/M.Sc (Biotechnology or relevant life sciences discipline) with a minimum of 55% marks. Candidates must have qualified CSIR-UGC-NET-JRFLS/DBT-JRF/ICMR-JRF/GATE. JRF#1: prior experience in handling fungal cultures, PGPR screening and characterisation, pot experiments, plant-microbial interactions, bioinformatics analysis, physiological and biochemical estimation of abiotic stress markers, detection of secondary metabolites, LC-MS/GC-MS. JRF#2: prior experience in biopolymer extraction, derivatisation and characterisation, hydrogel/biomaterial/composite formulation and characterisation, bioprocess engineering. Candidates must have proficiency in scientific writing, data analysis/interpretation and lab management.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship runs till the end of the project and is initially offered for 01 year, subject to satisfactory performance. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.

rows.fellowship: Rs. 37,000 + 9% HRA p.m., as per the sanction order and DBT, GoI guidelines, for NET/GATE/relevant national-level exam-qualified candidates

For queries about the project, write to [email protected] or [email protected] . Documents named in the notice: latest CV and other credentials.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed through email regarding the interview process. The notice does not give the interview date, mode or venue.
